name: mx
description: How the @motifx-community/design-system token sets combine for the default design language, Tactile: the shared primitives, then its scales, its theme and its density. Every other language has a resolver of its own next to this one (lounge.resolver.json), because its themes and densities are its own files. Design Tokens Resolver Module 2025.10.

primitive.description: Shared palette and scales. Never consumed directly by components; the same in every design language.

identity.description: The design language: its corner radii, shadows, type and motion. Same token names in every language, different values.

theme.description: Semantic colors and the focus ring per theme, as the chosen language defines them.

density.description: Control heights, paddings, gaps and the pressable feel, as the chosen language defines them.
